test_move_and_copy_casts: test pybind11 move and copy casts by counting move assignments and constructions for MoveOnlyInt types
test_move_and_copy_loads: test pybind11 move and copy loads by calling functions that load arguments via custom type casters
test_move_and_copy_load_optional: test pybind11 move and copy loads of std::optional arguments with move assignment and construction counts
test_lacking_copy_ctor: test that pybind11 raises a RuntimeError when accessing a non-copyable object via lacking_copy_ctor
test_move_fallback: test that pybind11 rvp::move falls through to copy on non-movable objects and returns correct values
